name: agentdock-platform
description: AgentDock Platform - Web Dashboard, Cloud/Local Sync Server, and VS Code Extension

scripts.test:coverage: node -e "fs.mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --test --import ./scripts/test-env.ts --test-timeout=60000 --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info backend/tests/*.test.ts frontend/tests/*.test.ts extension/tests/*.test.ts scripts/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check:coverage: npm run --silent test:coverage && node scripts/warn-window.ts 2026-12-05 scripts/coverage-gate.ts coverage/lcov.info
scripts.check:arch: node scripts/warn-window.ts 2026-12-05 node_modules/dependency-cruiser/bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs backend/src frontend/src extension/src --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs --output-type err
